item.tib: gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu las skong rdzogs chen mo
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ a dkar theg pa'i grol phug gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa la/ thugs dam dgyes spyod dbyings kyi skong rdzogs chen mo 'di yang / gsas mkhar gsang ba mchog gi dril sgrub/ 'chi med yum sras gsum gyi lung don/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs bcud/ dbal gshen stag la nyid kyis mdzad srol/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i brnag pa/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi smar byang / mkhas pa chen po de yis byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la sbas/ man ngag stang chen gyi thugs la gab bo/ phyis su rten 'brel legasapa'i skabs su bab pa'i kho bo bdag gi dngos grub 'di yang / dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' gsung phab pa dang / dad ldan rnams kyi gsung gis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod du/ lo dus kyi gsang rgya yol nas/ stang chen dmu tsha'i zhal lung bzhin du dkar chags (chag) yi ge ris su bris pa'o/ dge bas 'gro kun rig rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
